parameters.query: INSERT INTO oauth_states (state, shop_name, code_verifier, redirect_uri) VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4);

parameters.responseBody:
=Connect Etsy shop

Connect {{ $('Generate PKCE').item.json.shop_name }}

Click below to authorise n8n on Etsy. You'll be redirected back here when it's done.

Authorise on Etsy →

State token: {{ $('Generate PKCE').item.json.state }} (valid 10 min)

meta.description: GET /webhook/etsy-connect?shop_name=My+Shop → renders an HTML page with an Etsy OAuth authorise link. Generates PKCE state+verifier+challenge, persists them in oauth_states for 10 min so the callback (wf 04) can validate.
